purpose: Resolve the architecture, feature-availability, leakage, and training-design uncertainty about whether a bounded causal user-history representation can address severe underperformance in specific request-context tabs without violating the temporal protocol.
query: Causal, impression-time user behavior history features for logged-video recommendation, including sequence truncation, leakage-safe feature construction, candidate-aware pooling or attention, and evidence on within-user ranking metrics such as GAUC and nDCG@5, especially on KuaiRand or comparable short-video datasets.

purpose: Resolve whether the next scarce experiment should pursue multitask or watch-time modeling after the RankNet objective produced a negative primary gain, while retaining binary long_view as the fixed evaluation target and avoiding current-impression outcome leakage.
query: Auxiliary-task or censored watch-time objectives for long-view prediction in recommendation, comparing pointwise, pairwise, listwise, multitask engagement, and survival or censored-duration modeling under logged implicit-feedback data; report effects on top-k ranking and within-user AUC.
